report:
Reviewed the complete symbols.body_interfaces claim, both associated implementation files and both tests. Captured the symbols design, metadata trace fixture, body-forcing/root setup helpers and execution-log collection/draining. Source inspection only; no behavioral tests rerun and no source changes.

The claim permits a function's own source/signature and demanded semantic interfaces/metadata/solver facts, forbids callee or sibling body reads, and requires caller body stability and no reexecution after callee-body-only edits. LocalFnSym::body reads self.sig and self.cst, constructs its own checking context, imports signature/environment and checks only that CST before finalization. expr.rs def_to_ty handles local callees by reading local.sig, instantiating type parameters and submitting its parameter environment before producing FnPtr. It does not invoke local.body. Other expression paths consume demanded field/member/call facts rather than eagerly iterating function bodies. These entry paths support the semantic interface boundary; they do not alone prove the persistent edit requirement.

clone_method_body_has_a_narrow_reusable_semantic_query_trace forces DbDropGuard::db through a helper that asserts no checking diagnostics. The cold test compares the selected signature/item metadata operations against an exact sorted five-call list, forbids metadata call labels containing body, requires the separate item-name read and confirms a body query executed. It then repeats the request, requiring an empty metadata log and absence of body execution. Captured BuiltinDeriveTcx logging and Database WillExecute/draining show these are real cold/warm observations rather than reused log output. This is one meaningful interface/reuse scenario, but metadata labels do not prove the absence of every local sibling/callee body read, and the test performs no edit.

The symbols_body_interfaces TODO expressly retains the full callee-body edit matrix and sibling-body trace cases. Its prerequisite is persistent tests asserting both equal caller output and no caller reexecution after callee-body-only changes, alongside explicit forbidden local body dependencies. It contains no assertions and remains deferred. I do not weaken the claim's no-reexecution requirement to mere equal-output backdating or infer it from unchanged warm requests. All implementation entries and claim components are accounted for, with partial ordinary coverage clearly separated from the remaining verification. No concrete additional defect was identified in the inspected paths and no edits are requested.
